What ProFrac says to expect

  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresProFrac is updating its expectation that capital expenditures will be in a range of $160 million to $180 million, which includes Flotek’s current capital expenditure plan. Excluding Flotek, the Company expects that capital expenditures will be in a range of $145 million to $165 million for 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
